patch_description: The best-scoring prior program (total_cost 759.09 vs 1035.14 for plain Dijkstra) built a Steiner-like multicast tree: for each partition it grows a shared tree from src, attaching the nearest destination via multi-source Dijkstra over the current tree so shared trunk edges are only paid once, then reconstructs each dst's chain from parent pointers. I re-adopt that strategy, keeping the per-dst Dijkstra fallback guard for safety. This eliminates redundant per-destination transfers and exploits shared low-cost routes across the multi-network topology.
